title: Fan out requests with bounded concurrency
summary: Fetch many keys through a bounded worker pool, preserve input order, and cancel outstanding work on the first failure.
objectives: Fan out independent fetches with a bounded worker pool that preserves input order.
Cancel outstanding work when the first fetch fails and wait for every started goroutine to exit.
Keep goroutine and allocation counts proportional to the worker limit, not the key count.
constraints: Never start more than workers fetch calls concurrently.
Preserve input order; duplicate keys produce duplicate results.
Return the first fetch error wrapped as fetch {key}: {error} and cancel the rest.
Return nil, ctx.Err() without calling fetch when the context is already canceled.
Return an empty non-nil []Result and nil error for empty input.
Do not spawn one goroutine per key; respect the worker limit.

examples.output: [{Key: "a", Value: ...}, {Key: "b", Value: ...}, {Key: "c", Value: ...}] in input order
examples.explanation: Completion order does not decide result order.

examples.input: One fetch returns an error while others are still running
examples.output: nil, error "fetch b: ..."; every started fetch returns before FetchAll does
examples.explanation: The derived context cancels blocked fetches and the pool waits for them.

examples.output: Three results, with the x value repeated at the first and third positions
examples.explanation: Keys are tasks, so duplicates stay duplicated.

public.name: Ordered results
public.description: Results follow input order, duplicates repeat, and empty input stays non-nil.

public.name: Fetch failures
public.description: Errors wrap the failing key, cancel blocked fetches, and an already-canceled context does no work.

hidden.name: Completion order
hidden.description: Results stay in input order even when fetches finish in reverse order.

hidden.name: Concurrency bound
hidden.description: The pool never exceeds the worker limit and clamps invalid worker counts.

hidden.name: Cancellation
hidden.description: Blocked fetches observe cancellation and all started work finishes before returning.
